answer: A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and hence paying the sable bond on all of them and exposing each to the juniper slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 7 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. Because the zenith audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. Verification alone takes 8 days each. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
